requirements.text: GAP-11 MUST provide: Transactional persistence for allocations, releases, scrub state, quarantine state, and tenant security epochs across process/node restarts.
INV-STORE-1 a commit is visible iff its WAL line is complete and checksummed
INV-STORE-2 every write is CAS on explicit revisions
INV-STORE-3 corruption anywhere but a torn tail refuses to open
emit stable reason/event `STORE_CORRUPT` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `STALE_REVISION` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Monotonic ownership epochs or fencing tokens preventing two controllers from allocating the same physical accelerator after failover or partition.
INV-FENCE-1 token for a resource never decreases
INV-FENCE-2 a write with a lower token is refused atomically
emit stable reason/event `STALE_FENCE` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Explicit active-controller authority and failover behavior, integrated with fencing rather than best-effort locks.
INV-LEAD-1 at most one controller believes it leads outside its safety margin
INV-LEAD-2 epochs strictly increase across holders
emit stable reason/event `NOT_LEADER` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `leader_change` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Reclaim or quarantine resources after workload/controller death without prematurely releasing live workloads.
INV-TTL-1 unknown liveness never reclaims before grace
INV-TTL-2 reclaim leaves the device DIRTY
emit stable reason/event `AMBIGUOUS_EVIDENCE` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `LEASE_EXPIRED` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Request IDs and durable deduplication for allocate/release/scrub calls.
INV-IDEM-1 same id + same payload -> same result, no second effect
INV-IDEM-2 same id + different payload -> refused
emit stable reason/event `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `DUPLICATE_REQUEST` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Integration with GAP-02 and vendor APIs for device identity, memory, features, health, and hot-plug changes.
INV-INV-1 identity keyed by stable_id, never PCI address
INV-INV-2 provider outage never implies removal
emit stable reason/event `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `SCHEMA_INVALID` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Representation of mutually compatible partition profiles and creation/destruction/drain operations for MIG/SR-IOV/vendor slices.
INV-PART-1 a profile never oversubscribes memory
INV-PART-2 no reconfigure with active leases
emit stable reason/event `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `CONFIG_INVALID` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Actual VRAM/HBM/state zeroization or reset with timeout, retry policy, health verification, and evidence.
INV-SCRUB-1 a device crosses tenants only after a verified scrub
INV-SCRUB-2 timeout/partial/unknown -> QUARANTINED
emit stable reason/event `SCRUB_FAILED` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `SCRUB_TIMEOUT` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Cryptographic binding between discovered accelerator identity/capabilities, node identity, driver/firmware state, and GAP-06 attestation evidence.
INV-ATT-1 capability used for placement equals the attested digest
emit stable reason/event `ATTESTATION_INVALID` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-PKI; BLK-ADJ
GAP-11 MUST provide: mTLS/workload identity or equivalent authentication for inventory, allocate, release, and scrub APIs.
INV-AUTHN-1 no state change without a verified principal
emit stable reason/event `UNAUTHENTICATED` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `REPLAY_DETECTED` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-PKI
GAP-11 MUST provide: Tenant/workload permissions for device classes, partitions, administrative scrub, quarantine overrides, and sensitive inventory.
INV-AUTHZ-1 tenant comes from the principal, never the body
INV-AUTHZ-2 no rule -> deny
emit stable reason/event `POLICY_DENIED` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Concrete JSON/Protobuf/WIT/RPC schema files for accelerator inventory, allocation, release, and scrub interfaces, including compatibility rules.
INV-WIRE-1 no business logic on an unvalidated message
emit stable reason/event `SCHEMA_INVALID` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Bounded request queues, deadlines, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, and structured failure mapping.
INV-SVC-1 bounded in-flight; excess -> OVERLOADED
emit stable reason/event `OVERLOADED` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-PKI
GAP-11 MUST provide: Per-tenant/project caps, reservation classes, starvation prevention, queue discipline, and capacity ceilings.
INV-Q-1 no quota -> no access
INV-Q-2 any queued request is served within 2*aging_s of reaching the head class
emit stable reason/event `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `OVERLOADED` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Authoritative hooks for workload start, exit, crash, eviction, and restart so leases cannot leak or be released too early.
INV-LC-1 a late event never resurrects or double-releases a lease
emit stable reason/event `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `LEASE_NOT_FOUND` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ADJ
GAP-11 MUST provide: Multi-controller fault tests proving fencing under delayed messages, network partitions, failover, and replay.
INV-SB-1 at most one lease per whole device under any interleaving
emit stable reason/event `STALE_FENCE` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: NUMA/PCIe/NVLink/fabric locality, gang allocation, atomic multi-device reservation, and rollback.
INV-GANG-1 no partial gang is ever persisted
emit stable reason/event `CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Profile compatibility and placement minimizing unusable residual accelerator capacity.
INV-FRAG-1 slice placement never lands on a whole-device lease
GAP-11 MUST provide: Live constraint integration with GAP-10 so thermally unavailable devices cannot be leased.
INV-THERM-1 missing or stale reading => not admissible
emit stable reason/event `THERMAL_UNAVAILABLE` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ADJ
GAP-11 MUST provide: ECC, Xid/device faults, link degradation, reset storms, predictive failure, and automatic quarantine/drain.
INV-RAS-1 failed health => QUARANTINED, excluded
emit stable reason/event `HARDWARE_FAULT` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Safely handle device disappearance, replacement, renumbering, and changed capabilities while leases exist.
INV-HP-1 a returning device is never directly placeable
emit stable reason/event `DEVICE_MISSING` on the relevant path
emit stable reason/event `AMBIGUOUS_EVIDENCE` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Priority classes or reserved accelerators, including safe preemption semantics where enabled.
INV-PRE-1 never preempt equal or higher priority
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ADJ
GAP-11 MUST provide: Precedence for security, residency, workload class, generation, feature, cost, power, and SLO constraints, with deterministic decision reasons.
INV-CON-1 scoring never overrides a hard constraint
emit stable reason/event `CONSTRAINT_UNSATISFIED` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Signed/chained events for allocation, release, scrub, quarantine, policy decisions, overrides, and controller leadership changes.
INV-AUD-1 any edit/reorder/delete fails verify; truncation fails against witness
emit stable reason/event `STORE_CORRUPT` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-KMS
GAP-11 MUST provide: Allocation latency, refusal reason, active leases, saturation, scrub latency/failure, queue depth, fragmentation, and reconciliation state.
INV-MET-1 label values come from closed sets
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Stable operation/request/lease/device IDs, trace context, privacy controls, and correlation to release lineage.
INV-LOG-1 secrets never reach a sink
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Version, configuration digest, dependency health, controller role, reconciliation lag, and safe explain output.
INV-HEALTH-1 not leader or store read-only => not ready
GAP-11 MUST provide: Separate capacity exhaustion, policy rejection, scrub failure, device health failure, attack indicators, and software defects.
INV-ALERT-1 every rule names a runbook
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Validation, secure defaults, site/environment overlays, provenance, atomic activation, and rollback.
INV-CFG-1 an invalid candidate is never partially active
emit stable reason/event `CONFIG_INVALID` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Certificate/key retrieval, rotation, redaction, and fail-closed behavior when key or identity services are unavailable.
INV-SEC-1 a secret value never appears in config, logs or audit
emit stable reason/event `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` on the relevant path
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-KMS
GAP-11 MUST provide: Durable device/partition occupancy records suitable for capacity analytics, chargeback/showback, and audit without trusting ephemeral process memory.
INV-USE-1 every lease has exactly one usage record, closed on release/reclaim
GAP-11 MUST provide: Explicit freeze, drain, unquarantine, force-reconcile, and maintenance workflows with authorization and audit.
INV-OP-1 the only exit from QUARANTINED is a verified scrub
emit stable reason/event `MAINTENANCE_MODE` on the relevant path
GAP-11 MUST provide: Golden requests/responses/error cases for every wire interface.
INV-FIX-1 every fixture decodes to its expected outcome
GAP-11 MUST provide: GAP-02, GAP-06, GAP-09, GAP-10, workload placement, runtime, and workload lifecycle integration tests.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ADJ
GAP-11 MUST provide: Request parsing, schema handling, state-machine sequences, lease replay, and malformed inventory.
INV-FUZZ-1 decoder raises only typed ControlError
GAP-11 MUST provide: Release-vs-scrub, allocate-vs-inventory-change, controller failover, multi-device transactions, and long-running race/soak tests.
INV-CONC-1 invariants hold under every tested interleaving
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: Spoofed identity, capability escalation, stale lease replay, denial of service, side-channel assumptions, audit tampering, and malicious device metadata.
INV-ADV-1 every adversarial case is refused with a typed code
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: Store loss, partial write, process kill, node loss, network partition, time skew, dependency outage, and reconnect.
INV-FAULT-1 retry after restart converges to exactly one effect
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV
GAP-11 MUST provide: p50/p95/p99/worst-case latency, burst/overload, fleet size, queue depth, memory/CPU overhead, and regression gates.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV; BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Supported Python/pk_core versions, API schema versions, architectures, drivers, firmware, hypervisors, accelerator families, and providers.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HW
GAP-11 MUST provide: pyproject/build metadata, explicit pk_core compatibility range, reproducible wheel/sdist or repository packaging, and installation tests.
GAP-11 MUST provide: Compile, unit, contract, integration, security, fuzz, benchmark, provenance, and artifact verification before release.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-SIGN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Signed release artifacts, dependency inventory, source/build attestations, and verification policy.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-SIGN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Attacker classes, trust boundaries, residual-data threat analysis, stale-controller threats, side-channel assumptions, and mitigations.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Approved technology/state-store/API/fencing choices and explicit tradeoffs.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Owner, on-call/escalation route, incident severity policy, and support commitment.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Bootstrap, rollout, rollback, emergency disable, store recovery, orphan reconciliation, failed scrub, device replacement, and incident containment.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-ENV; BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Owners, expiry dates, rationale, migration plan, and review cadence.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Restore the authoritative master prompt/workflow source or remove all downstream assumptions that require it.
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-MASTER; BLK-HUMAN
GAP-11 MUST provide: Machine-readable acceptance results covering architecture, security, resilience, performance, observability, rollback, ownership, and all unresolved exceptions.
INV-EXIT-1 any open P0 item or unapproved exception => NO_GO
operate under a time-bounded APPROVED exception while blockers remain: BLK-HUMAN
